title: Colored Turán densities and finite directed templates
summary: Classical Turán theory relates the asymptotic extremal problem for an ordinary forbidden graph to its chromatic number. This principle fails when a forbidden copy must respect prescribed vertex colors, as occurs naturally in multipartite extremal problems and in embeddings with prescribed clusters. We study properly vertex-colored graphs whose hosts have a prescribed density between every pair of color classes, with containment interpreted through color-preserving homomorphisms.
